battle.name: 俄國內戰
battle.theater: 歐俄戰線與西伯利亞鐵路走廊
battle.brief: 一九一七年十月革命之後，帝國軍隊瓦解、列強干涉接踵而至，一九一八年三月布列斯特和約與白軍首次庫班遠征使內戰全面化，直至一九二二年方告收束。紅軍、白軍、海軍游擊隊與協約國干涉軍在歐俄、烏拉爾、西伯利亞、克里米亞拉鋒三年。卡面這挺一八六〇年的加特林機槍，此時已被水冷式 Maxim M1910 取代，只在後方守備與裝甲列車上勉強服役。

kit.name: 加特林機槍
kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰方主要有三層，加上介入的聯軍與數支武裝。第一層是紅軍，即布爾什維克主導的蘇維埃俄國。一九一八年一月二十八日（舊曆）蘇維埃政府頒布法令建軍，同年五月成立以共產黨員為核心的軍事委員會，由列寧以人民委員會主席的身分主持大局，托洛茨基出任軍事、海軍人民委員，實際統率全軍，總司令一職先後由斯維琴、托洛茨基、弗里茨、圖哈恰夫斯基接任。紅軍骨幹是帝國陸軍留下的步兵與野戰炮兵，另有志願兵、徵召兵、一九一九年五月之後依勞動義務制大批入伍的工農，以及來自西班牙、匈牙利、芬蘭的國際縱隊；地方上則有民警與游擊隊配合。第二層是白軍，即以俄國志願軍為核心的反布爾什維克聯盟：一九一八年三月在庫爾曼・科爾尼洛夫率領下成立於頓河區，其後由 Anton Denikin 接任武裝部隊最高統帥；另有西伯利亞的高爾察克、克里米亞的 Wrangel、北愛沙尼亞的 Yudenich，各自擁有獨立的軍區、徵兵與後勤體系；四周還有大量地方白黨游擊隊、主張農民自治的綠軍武裝，以及從烏克蘭、高加索、克里米亞、中亞湧出的移民式志願隊。第三層是協約國與中列強的干涉軍：一九一八年秋起英國 Dunster 支隊進入穆爾曼斯克與阿爾漢格爾斯克，法國組織北俄遠征軍，美國派遣北俄遠征隊，日本出兵西伯利亞，意大利、加拿大與中國勞工團先後參與；橫貫西伯利亞的捷克斯洛伐克軍團則是規模最大的外來武裝。與此同時，波蘭與芬蘭在西部牽制紅軍，白軍在烏克蘭與高加索的油田招募石油部隊與鐵路工作隊。整個戰區縱貫歐俄、烏拉爾、西伯利亞、中亞與北極圈，戰線全長以千公里計。
countriesEn: The belligerents fall into three layers, plus the foreign intervention and a number of irregular forces. The first layer is the Red Army, the armed force of Bolshevik-led Soviet Russia. On 28 January 1918 (Old Style) the Soviet government decreed the formation of the army, and in May of that year a Military Opposition Committee with the Communist Party at its centre was set up; Lenin, as chairman of the Council of People's Commissars, directed the state, while Trotsky became People's Commissar for Military and Naval Affairs and actually commanded the armed forces, the office of commander-in-chief passing in turn to Svechin, Trotsky, Frunze and Tukhachevsky. The backbone of the Red Army was the infantry and field artillery inherited from the imperial army, joined by volunteers, by conscripts, by the mass of workers and peasants enrolled after May 1919 under the labour conscription law, and by International Brigades from Spain, Hungary and Finland; on the local level, militia units and partisan detachments operated alongside the regular formations. The second layer is the White Army, an anti-Bolshevik coalition built around the Russian Volunteer Army: founded in March 1918 in the Don region under Lavr Kornilov, it was later led by Anton Denikin as commander-in-chief of the armed forces; separately, Kolchak in Siberia, Wrangel in Crimea and Yudenich in northern Estonia each commanded their own theatres, their own recruiting and their own logistics; around them lay numerous local White partisan bands, the peasant autonomist Green movements, and volunteer detachments of emigrants from Ukraine, the Caucasus, Crimea and Central Asia. The third layer is the intervention of the Entente and of Japan: from the autumn of 1918 the British Dunster Force entered Murmansk and Archangel, France organised a North Russia expeditionary corps, the United States sent a North Russia expeditionary force, Japan deployed troops into Siberia, and Italian, Canadian and Chinese labour detachments followed; the Czechoslovak Legion, straddling the Trans-Siberian Railway, was the largest foreign contingent of all. Meanwhile Poland and Finland tied down the Reds in the west, and the Whites recruited oil and railway working battalions in the fields of Ukraine and the Caucasus. The whole theatre stretched across European Russia, the Urals, Siberia, Central Asia and the Arctic, and the front ran to a length measured in thousands of kilometres.
people: 列寧是全場的決策者。他力主拒絕任何已經簽妥的交換、以割地換取喘息，又在一九一八年七月左派社會革命黨人於莫斯科暗殺德國駐俄大使 Mirbach 未遂、蘇維埃政權在莫斯科等地遭到武裝襲擊之後，推動成立非常委員會，把鎮壓反革命的權力收進同一個機關。托洛茨基是紅軍的建造者：他在一九一八年頒布游擊戰指令，一九一九年設立鐵路人民委員部，把鐵路、煤油與糧食的調度統一置於作戰指揮之下，並在一九一八至一九一九年冬組織紅軍自南方反攻，迫使 Kolchak 的西伯利亞政權崩潰；他「不撤軍」的指示與他同斯維琴的權力衝突，最終在一九一九年被迫去職、一九二〇年復任。斯維琴是主張軍事專業化的總司令，著有《軍事綱要》，反對把游擊戰神聖化，被同僚視為紅軍制度化的關鍵人物。弗里茨在南線策劃了對 Denikin 的戰略反攻，又指揮一九二〇年克里米亞戰役，紅軍的戰役理論在他手上成型。白軍方面：科爾尼洛夫建立志願軍，四月在向喀山的進攻中陣亡；Denikin 靠騎兵縱隊與一九一九年的北方攻勢一度逼近莫斯科外圍，最終在九月底的奧廖爾戰役被紅軍打崩；高爾察克在西伯利亞於一九一九年冬的卡馬河戰役之後崩潰，次年二月在伊爾庫茨克被處決；Wrangel 靠克里米亞的地形與精銳步兵撐過一九二〇年，最後在彼德科普與新羅西亞斯克之間全軍被殲或登船撤走；Yudenich 一九一九年十月率兩萬人自愛沙尼亞打到彼得格勒外圍，最後在納爾瓦與普斯科夫受挫。捷克斯洛伐克軍團的 Gajda 一九一八年企圖在西伯利亞另立政府而失敗，這次失敗直接加速了 Kolchak 的垮台。
peopleEn: Lenin was the man who decided everything. He insisted on refusing any exchange that had already been signed, accepting territorial losses in order to buy time, and after the Left Socialist-Revolutionaries attempted to assassinate the German ambassador Mirbach in Moscow in July 1918 and the Soviet government was itself attacked in arms in Moscow and elsewhere, he pressed for the creation of the extraordinary commission, gathering the power to crush the counter-revolution into a single organ. Trotsky built the Red Army: he issued the directive on partisan warfare in 1918, established the Railway People's Commissariat in 1919, placing the movement of rails, fuel and grain under the war command, and in the winter of 1918-19 organised the Red counter-offensive from the south that drove Kolchak's Siberian regime to collapse; his order not to give ground, and the bitter conflict with Svechin over the conduct of the war, ended with his removal in 1919 and his return in 1920. Svechin, commander-in-chief and author of the Military Doctrine, argued for professional military command against the sanctification of partisan warfare, and his colleagues saw him as the key to the institutionalisation of the Red Army. Frunze planned the strategic counter-offensive against Denikin on the southern front and directed the Crimean campaign of 1920, and the operational theory of the Red Army took shape in his hands. On the White side, Kornilov raised the Volunteer Army and was killed in April during the advance towards Kazan; Denikin, with mounted columns and the northern offensive of 1919, came within reach of the approaches to Moscow, only to be broken at Orel at the end of September; Kolchak's Siberian regime collapsed after the defeat on the Kama in the winter of 1919-20, and he was executed at Irkutsk in February 1920; Wrangel held the Crimea through 1920 on its ground and its disciplined infantry, and was finally destroyed or evacuated by ship between Perekop and Novorossiysk; Yudenich marched twenty thousand men from Estonia to the outskirts of Petrograd in October 1919 and was checked at Narva and Pskov. Gajda of the Czechoslovak Legion tried in 1918 to set up a separate government in Siberia and failed, and that failure directly accelerated Kolchak's collapse.
kits: 卡面這挺一八六〇年的加特林機槍，在一九一八年的俄羅斯已是上一代的武器。它靠人力搖柄讓六根槍管依次後退復進，把後坐力分攤在六次行程上，換來高射速與可持續的壓制；卡面銘文所說的「能壓住一個師」，正是它的設計目標。它用定裝紙殼藥包整匣裝填，怕潮怕髒，槍管無水冷，連射之後散熱不良，機體沉重，還得留出專人搖柄——這些弱點在俄羅斯的漫長冬季裡格外致命。俄軍的制式機槍早已換成一九〇四年引進的水冷式 Maxim M1910，皮帶供彈、每分鐘五百發、四人小組即可拖行，另有前線繳獲的各類輕機槍。內戰中雙方都大量沿用帝國時代的存量裝備，加特林因此沒有立刻退場：少數被固定在裝甲列車與裝甲車的旋轉砲塔上，充當近距封鎖火力，另有相當數量被地方武裝與後方守備隊當作現成而便宜的重武器；這方面的零散記載不少，把它當作野戰主力的場面則極少。真正決定戰局的裝備是另一個量級：步兵的莫辛-納甘特一八九一/三〇式步槍與一八九五式三發步槍、哥薩克騎兵用卡賓槍與騎刀、Schwarzlose M1896 速射手槍、步兵連屬的七六毫米野戰炮與師屬榴彈炮、數量不多的法國雷納 FT 坦克與裝甲列車，以及英法日在西伯利亞與北俄運來的機槍、迫擊炮、鐵路車輛與後勤器材；紅軍另有由卡車改裝的裝甲車、由德國輸入的造幣廠印鈔能力，以及一套龐大的徵糧機構，用來養活百萬量級的軍隊。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun on the card, of 1860, was already a weapon of the previous generation by 1918. It was worked by a hand crank that made six barrels recoil and advance in turn, dividing the recoil over six strokes and buying a high rate of fire with sustained pressure; the line on the card, that it can hold down a division, is precisely its design goal. It fired fixed paper cartridges loaded in blocks, it hated damp and dirt, its barrels had no water jacket and overheated after a long burst, the machine was heavy, and it had to be cranked by men posted to the job; against the Russian winter these were fatal weaknesses. The standard machine gun of the Russian army had long since been the water-cooled Maxim M1910, introduced in 1904, belt-fed, firing five hundred rounds a minute and dragged by a four-man team, together with the light machine guns captured on the front. Since both sides in the civil war drew heavily on the imperial stocks, the Gatling did not vanish at once: a few were fixed in the rotating turrets of armoured trains and armoured cars to blockade narrow approaches, and a fair number were taken up by local armed bands and rear-area garrisons as ready-made heavy weapons that were cheap to use. The evidence for this is scattered; the number of occasions on which a Gatling served as a field main weapon is very small. The equipment that actually decided the war belonged to another order of magnitude: the Mosin-Nagant 1891/30 infantry rifle and the three-round 1895 rifle, carbines and shashkas for the Cossack cavalry, the Schwarzlose M1896 machine pistol, the 76 mm regimental gun and the divisional howitzer, the small number of French Renault FT tanks and the armoured trains, and the machine guns, mortars, rolling stock and supplies brought in by Britain, France and Japan to Siberia and the north. The Reds added armoured cars rebuilt from lorries, the printing presses and coinage works that came out of Germany, and a vast requisitioning apparatus, all of it employed to keep an army of millions in the field.
tactics: 紅軍的戰術在三年間經歷了兩次轉向。一九一八年春天，內戰以游擊隊為主：邊區的正規營連只在鐵路沿線的據點固守，靠襲擊敵後、破壞橋樑、徵發糧秣來拖住白軍；同年秋冬，紅軍改採全線進攻加上鐵路重奪的樣板戰役，由第五軍在喀山得手、第六與第七集團軍在烏拉爾戰線反攻，迫使 Kolchak 的軍隊節節後退。一九一九年春夏，紅軍在敵後縱深發動多次戰役性反擊，斯維琴主張的「小股迂迴加正面突破」由弗里茨在對 Denikin 的作戰中發揚：步兵密集縱隊在炮兵與機槍掩護下突破白軍陣地，騎兵集團軍緊接著向縱深突進，切斷敵方後方的鐵路與糧道。一九二〇年，弗里茨主持統一大戰役，白軍的南線與東南線被同時壓制；紅軍以裝甲列車充當移動砲台，沿鐵路推出，炮火直接支援地面突擊，白軍的縱隊往往推進數百公里之後，因彈藥與糧食耗盡而停滯。干涉軍的戰術樣板是港口登陸加上鐵路據點固守：日軍在海參崴與哈巴羅夫斯克立據，英法美軍守住穆爾曼斯克與阿爾漢格爾斯克的北極航道，捷克斯洛伐克軍團沿西伯利亞鐵路節節東進；這些據點彼此相隔極遠，難以互相支援，最終被紅軍以火車輪戰逐一拔除。白軍的戰術長於縱隊機動與騎兵閃擊，短於鞏固占領區：Yudenich 的北方攻勢十日之間打到彼得格勒外圍，卻因後方鐵路被游擊隊切斷而無從補給；Denikin 一九一九年攻入烏克蘭之後同樣因糧運線過長而在奧廖爾崩潰。紅軍方面還有一項不尋常的殘酷手段：一九一九年九月，白軍在察里津方向以德國供應的毒氣炮彈攻擊紅軍騎兵，紅軍因此在作戰條例中正式加入毒氣防護的規定。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the Red Army changed direction twice in three years. In the spring of 1918 the war was fought mainly by partisan detachments: the regular companies of the interior counties dug in only at stations and depots along the railway, and the war was kept alive by raids on the enemy rear, by the destruction of bridges and by requisitioning food. That autumn and winter the Reds turned to set-piece campaigns of a general type, the model being the capture of Kazan by the Fifth Army and the counter-offensive of the Sixth and Seventh Combined Armies on the Urals front, which drove Kolchak's troops back step by step. In the spring and summer of 1919 the Reds struck deep into the enemy's rear, and the pattern of small flanking movement combined with a frontal break proposed by Svechin was developed by Frunze against Denikin: infantry in dense columns went forward under cover of artillery and machine-gun fire, and the cavalry groups immediately pushed into the enemy's depth to cut the railway and the supply route behind him. In 1920 Frunze coordinated a single great campaign that pressed the southern and south-eastern fronts at once; the armoured trains served as mobile artillery platforms, pushed forward along the lines, firing directly in support of the infantry assault, and White columns would advance hundreds of kilometres and then simply stop for want of ammunition and food. The interventionists fought by the standard pattern of a seaborne landing combined with the holding of railway points: the Japanese established themselves at Vladivostok and Khabarovsk, the British, French and Americans held the Arctic route at Murmansk and Archangel, and the Czechoslovak Legion advanced east step by step along the Trans-Siberian Railway. These positions were enormously far apart and could not support one another, and the Reds took them down one by one with a war of the trains. White tactics excelled at mobile columns and cavalry raids and were poor at holding occupied ground: Yudenich's northern offensive reached the outskirts of Petrograd within ten days, but with the railway behind him cut by partisans he could not be fed; Denikin's advance into Ukraine in 1919 broke down at Orel for the same reason, his lines of communication having grown too long. The Reds also employed a brutal expedient: in September 1919 the Whites fired poison gas shells, supplied by Germany, at Red cavalry in the Tsaritsyn sector, and the Red Army added gas precautions to its field regulations in consequence.
data: 內戰的時間軸大致是：一九一七年十月二十五日（舊曆）十月革命爆發；一九一八年三月三日布列斯特和約簽訂，同月二十七日白軍發動第一次庫班遠征，內戰全面化；一九二〇年十一月克里米亞白軍登船撤走；一九二二年十月遠東最後一批白軍退出海參崴；蘇維埃政府於一九二二年十二月三十日成立蘇聯時，內戰才算正式收束。兵力的膨脹極為驚人：紅軍從一九一八年初的三十萬人左右，增至一九一九年底超過一百萬，一九二〇年秋達三百七十萬，十一月巔峰約五百三十萬人。白軍方面，Kolchak 的西伯利亞軍與 Denikin 的南俄軍合計常被估為數十萬，Yudenich 一九一九年的北方集群約兩萬人，Wrangel 在克里米亞至多維持十萬上下；協約國干涉軍的總數約二十萬，分布卻極其分散，日本在西伯利亞約七萬，英軍約三萬至五萬，法軍約三萬，美軍約一萬五千，捷克斯洛伐克軍團約五萬。傷亡統計分歧極大，通行說法是死亡總數在七百萬至一千二百萬之間，其中紅軍因戰鬥、疾病與飢餓死亡的合計約三百萬至四百萬人，這些數字都只能當作量級來看。距離與後勤方面，橫貫歐亞的西伯利亞大鐵路全長逾九千公里，一支部隊要靠它連續運輸數千公里；而 Kolchak 一九一九年西進時自估距莫斯科尚有約一千五百公里，最終在卡馬河與喀山一線耗盡。
dataEn: The chronology of the civil war runs roughly as follows. The October Revolution broke out on 25 October 1917 (Old Style). Brest-Litovsk was signed on 3 March 1918, and on 27 March of that year the Whites launched their first march on the Kuban, and the war became general. In November 1920 the Crimean Whites boarded their ships. In October 1922 the last White forces withdrew from Vladivostok in the Far East, and the civil war formally closed when the Soviet government proclaimed the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics on 30 December 1922. The growth of the armies was astonishing: the Red Army went from roughly three hundred thousand men in early 1918 to over a million by the end of 1919, to about three and a half million by the autumn of 1920, and to a peak of some five million three hundred thousand in November. On the White side, the Siberian army of Kolchak and the southern armies of Denikin together are commonly estimated in the hundreds of thousands; Yudenich's northern group in 1919 numbered about twenty thousand; Wrangel could maintain at most around a hundred thousand in Crimea. The foreign intervention amounted to about two hundred thousand men spread extremely thinly: about seventy thousand Japanese in Siberia, thirty to fifty thousand British, about thirty thousand French, some fifteen thousand Americans, and roughly fifty thousand Czechoslovaks. Casualty figures vary enormously; the figure usually given is between seven and twelve million dead, of whom three to four million were Reds who died in battle, of disease and of hunger, and such numbers can only be read as orders of magnitude. Distance and logistics told the rest of the story: the Trans-Siberian Railway runs more than nine thousand kilometres, and an army had to be supplied along it for thousands of kilometres at a stretch; and when Kolchak advanced west in 1919 he reckoned that some fifteen hundred kilometres still separated him from Moscow, a distance he exhausted on the Kama and around Kazan.
cause: 導火線是國家的崩解。一九一七年二月革命推翻沙皇，臨時政府既不能解決土地、糧食與民族問題，也無法終止與德國的戰爭；十月革命推翻臨時政府，布爾什維克在一年之內以法令沒收土地、退出對德戰爭、清洗舊軍官。但內戰之所以打到三年規模，關鍵在布列斯特和約：它割讓了波蘭王國、芬蘭、烏克蘭、高加索與波羅的海沿岸的大片土地，並在國內扶植一個以德國為靠山的政府，反對派因此認定蘇維埃國家已淪為德國的附庸。一九一八年七月七日左派社會革命黨人在莫斯科暗殺德國大使 Mirbach 未遂，隨後在莫斯科、坦波夫等地爆發武裝起義，得到德國支持的白俄軍官與反革命立刻倒戈，全國裂成兩半。深層原因是第一次世界大戰的消耗與解體：帝國陸軍在戰俘營中大批復原而未經解散，軍官團拒絕接受停戰，農民要求土地與糧食，各少數民族趁蘇維埃中央虛弱宣布獨立，烏克蘭在一九一七年十二月宣布獨立，芬蘭亦在同月宣布獨立，白軍則把這些運動收編為自己的政治軍綱。最後是列強的介入：協約國出於反布爾什維克與遏制德國的雙重目的策劃「大俄羅斯計劃」，想在西伯利亞扶植一個以 Kolchak 為首的親西方緩衝國，最終派兵登陸西伯利亞與北極，內戰因此變成一場有國際干涉的戰爭。
causeEn: The trigger was the disintegration of the state. The February Revolution of 1917 overthrew the Tsar, but the Provisional Government could settle neither the questions of land, food and nationality nor bring the war with Germany to an end; the October Revolution overthrew the Provisional Government, and within a year the Bolsheviks had nationalised the land, withdrawn from the war against Germany and purged the old officers. The war nevertheless ran to the scale of three years because of Brest-Litovsk: it ceded the Kingdom of Poland, Finland, Ukraine, the Caucasus and the Baltic littoral, and installed inside the country a government that leaned on Germany, so that the opposition concluded that the Soviet state had become a dependency of Germany. On 7 July 1918 the Left Socialist-Revolutionaries attempted to assassinate the German ambassador Mirbach in Moscow, and armed risings followed in Moscow, in Tambov and elsewhere; German-backed officers and the counter-revolution took up arms at once and the country split in two. The deeper causes were the exhaustion and dissolution of the First World War: the imperial army was demobilised in vast numbers out of the prisoner-of-war camps without being disarmed, the officer corps refused the armistice, the peasants wanted land and bread, and the national minorities proclaimed independence while the Soviet centre was weak — Ukraine in December 1917, Finland in the same month — and the Whites folded these movements into their own political programme. Last came the intervention of the Allies, animated both by hostility to Bolshevism and by the containment of Germany, who planned the Greater Russia scheme to create a Western-aligned buffer state in Siberia under Kolchak and ultimately landed troops in Siberia and in the Arctic. The civil war was in this way turned into a war with international involvement.
impact: 紅軍的勝利把蘇維埃國家從一個靠臨時措施維持的政權，變成全國唯一的軍事與政治權力。舊帝國的軍制、軍銜與參謀體系被整套替換，一九二〇年代的蘇聯紅軍一度膨脹到五百萬人，其佔國家支出的比重遠高於任何其他部門。經濟上，戰時共產主義的強制徵糧、配給制與全國性短缺成為一代人的記憶；一九二一年戰事甫一結束便轉入新經濟政策，農村的餘糧重新允許自由買賣。政治上，黨內的軍事反對派被清除，一黨執政與命令型國家機器最終成形，紅軍的隊列被改造成社會改造的工具，掃盲運動與文化教育同時在部隊中推行。國際上，芬蘭、愛沙尼亞、拉脫維亞與波蘭獲得獨立或自治，波蘇戰爭以《里加和約》劃定波蘭東部邊界，紅軍的戰役經驗後來發展成蘇聯的大縱深戰役理論，裝甲兵、摩托化與航空兵種都在這幾年成形。技術史上，這場戰爭是裝甲列車與飛機大規模用於實戰的開端之一，紅軍的裝甲列車衝鋒與北極航道上的護航作戰都在此時定型。對白軍而言，失敗意味著流亡：Wrangel 的克里米亞一度聚集數萬俄國流亡者，Denikin、Yudenich 等人先後在歐洲流亡，這批人日後成為反蘇組織與移民社群的骨幹，把這段歷史帶到海外保存下去；而紅軍的勝利，同時預示了二十餘年後歐洲戰爭中蘇聯與德國之間同樣的理論與裝備交會。
impactEn: The victory of the Reds turned a state kept alive by emergency measures into the single military and political authority in the country. The military system, the ranks and the staff structure of the old empire were replaced wholesale, and the Soviet Red Army reached five million men in the 1920s, taking a share of state spending higher than that of any other department. Economically, the forced grain requisition, the rationing and the general shortage of the war communism years became the memory of a generation, and once the fighting ended in 1921 the New Economic Policy followed at once, allowing the peasantry to trade its surplus freely again. Politically, the military opposition inside the party was purged, the one-party state and the command system took their final shape, the ranks of the Red Army were turned into an instrument of social transformation, and mass literacy and cultural education were carried on inside the units at the same time. Internationally, Finland, Estonia, Latvia and Poland won independence or autonomy, and the Polish-Soviet war was closed by the Treaty of Riga, which drew the eastern frontier of Poland; the operational experience of the Reds was later developed into the Soviet theory of deep operations, and the armoured, motorised and air arms of the army all took shape in these years. In technical history this war was one of the first in which armoured trains and aircraft were used on a large scale in combat, the armoured train offensives of the Reds and the escort work on the Arctic route both being settled here. For the Whites the defeat meant exile: Wrangel's Crimea briefly held tens of thousands of Russian refugees, and Denikin, Yudenich and others went into exile in Europe, where they became the backbone of the anti-Soviet organisations and of the émigré communities, carrying this history abroad to preserve it; at the same time the Red victory prefigured the meeting of Soviet and German theory and equipment in the war in Europe more than twenty years later.
result: 結果是紅軍的全面勝利，但這場勝利用了三年，也耗盡了國家。白軍的系統在戰線上被逐一消滅：西伯利亞的 Kolchak 政權在一九一九年冬崩潰，Yudenich 的北方攻勢在一九一九年十月被擋在彼得格勒之外，Denikin 的一九一九年攻勢在奧廖爾被逆轉，Wrangel 在一九二〇年十一月於彼德科普被突破、於新羅西亞斯克登船撤離克里米亞，其精銳幾乎未經損失便被逐出俄羅斯本土。殘餘的白軍退入森林與邊境，變成游擊隊：一九二一年三月 Kronstadt 碼頭的起義被炮火平定，同年坦波夫省由 Antonov 率領的農民游擊戰一直打到一九二二年，最後一名大隊級指揮官於一九二四年被消滅。白軍首領的下場各異：Kolchak 於一九二〇年二月七日在伊爾庫茨克被處決，Denikin 在巴黎流亡至一九四七年，Wrangel 則死在歐洲的一次軍事行動中。紅軍方面，戰後留下的是一支龐大的軍隊與更龐大的財政負擔，直到一九二四年才大規模裁軍，軍人安置成為新國家最棘手的社會問題。一九二二年十二月三十日，蘇維埃社會主義共和國聯邦成立，內戰在法律意義上結束；而從一九二一年起已公開實行的新經濟政策，以及此後的集體化，說明這場戰爭真正結算的帳，是從一戰的廢墟之中建起一個新國家，而不是恢復舊俄羅斯。
resultEn: The result was an outright Red victory, but that victory took three years and exhausted the country. The White system was destroyed front by front: the Siberian regime of Kolchak collapsed in the winter of 1919-20; Yudenich's northern offensive was halted outside Petrograd in October 1919; Denikin's offensive of 1919 was reversed at Orel; and in November 1920 Wrangel was broken at Perekop and evacuated by ship from Novorossiysk, his best troops being driven out of the Russian mainland with remarkably few losses. The White remnant withdrew into the forests and the borderlands and turned into partisan war: the rising of the Kronstadt sailors in March 1921 was put down by gunfire, and the peasant insurgency in Tambov province led by Antonov ran on through 1922, the last group commander of it being killed in 1924. The fates of the White leaders differed: Kolchak was executed at Irkutsk on 7 February 1920, Denikin died in exile in Paris in 1947, and Wrangel was killed in a European military action. On the Red side, the war left behind an enormous army and an even larger fiscal burden, and the demobilisation on a large scale did not come until 1924, when the resettlement of the soldiers became the most difficult social problem of the new state. On 30 December 1922 the Union of Soviet Socialist Republics was proclaimed and the civil war ended in law; and the New Economic Policy, publicly begun as early as 1921, together with the collectivisation that followed, shows that the real reckoning of this war was the building of a new state out of the ruins of the First World War, and not the restoration of old Russia.
